baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional existence clause kana lakum is followed by the noun-to-imperative repetition kayd ... fakiduni and a first-person object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal or existential predication tests whether a stratagem is actually available, and the repeated root requires claimed possession to become direct execution against the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Being or temporal predication makes the availability of the alleged resource the condition under examination.
Plotting and stratagem supply both the claimed resource and the commanded adversarial act.

changed_reading.before: A generic instruction to plot if a plot is available.
changed_reading.after: Any stratagem claimed as a possession must now be made operative and directed against the speaker; the line is a capability challenge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root occurs as the indefinite noun kayd and the imperative kiduni, so the proposed capacity and its exertion are verbally coupled.
baseline_models.mechanism: The forceful-handling branch shifts emphasis from hidden cleverness to strenuous intervention: whatever power of manipulation they possess is ordered into direct use.

activation_trace.role: Forceful handling turns kayd into strenuous operative pressure rather than only a concealed design.

changed_reading.before: Use whatever clever plan you have.
changed_reading.after: Exert whatever forceful counter-operation you can bring to bear directly against Me.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite kayd names what the plural addressees might possess, while kiduni demands that it be turned against the speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because kayd can name war or battle, the construction can move from covert plotting to an openly declared contest in which every available hostile capacity is summoned.

activation_trace.role: The war-and-battle branch recasts the repeated noun and imperative as possession and commencement of open combat.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are dared to devise a covert scheme.
changed_reading.after: The addressees are dared to wage whatever battle they can against the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event becomes fixed occurrence, receives a set time and terminal deferment, and arrives as judicial separation. In that completed timetable, kayd is no longer merely a scheme but any attempt to manipulate delay or displace the appointed outcome.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication asks whether the alleged counter-resource can be present at this now-fixed moment.
Stratagem, including maneuver through respite or delayed punishment, is the rival timing practice being tested.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the promised endpoint that a counter-plan would have to displace.
Falling and becoming fixed converts promise from forecast into an outcome certain to take hold.
Fixing something by a time or limit closes indefinite temporal room for maneuver.
A prescribed terminal time makes deferment bounded rather than an escape from realization.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood marks the appointed endpoint as already judicially active.

structural_cues: The sequence from 77:7 through 77:11-14 to 77:38 moves from promised occurrence, through timing and deferment, to the Day of Separation immediately before the challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed temporal and judicial chain plus the plotting branch; I infer that adversarial plotting can work by buying or rearranging time, so the challenge tests rival scheduling. A generic non-temporal scheme remains live.

changed_reading.after: At the appointment that has already become fixed judgment, try to produce a scheme capable of altering the schedule or postponing its outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts of doing, creating, placing, and measuring establish an operative field controlled by the speaker. The forceful-handling branch then makes kayd a test of whether the addressees possess any rival operation within that field.

activation_trace.role: Forceful handling supplies the addressees' hypothetical counter-operation.
Bringing an act into effect establishes the speaker as an agent whose action has already operated on earlier criminals.
Originating creation supplies the most basic operation that any alleged rival capacity would have to confront.
Causing a thing to assume a state adds directed placement and transformation to the speaker's demonstrated agency.
Capacity that reaches action and mastery turns the named capable agents into the direct comparator for the addressees' claimed power.

structural_cues: The first-person plural action sequence in 77:16-27 precedes the first-person singular object in kiduni, converting cosmological assertions into a direct agency comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed divine operations and a focus branch of forceful handling; I infer an asymmetric capability test in which the addressees must counter-operate on an already ordered field. The narrower sense of intellectual plotting is still possible.

changed_reading.before: The challenge concerns cleverness in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The challenge audits whether the addressees can perform any effective counter-operation against the actor who has created, placed, measured, and destroyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective cover has failed to avail, speech is unavailable, and permission to excuse is withheld. The conditional if you have any kayd therefore functions as a final inventory check after defensive and procedural resources have been removed, carrying pragmatic disbelief rather than neutral uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: Existence predication makes remaining availability, not merely conceptual possibility, the point of the condition.
Stratagem becomes the residual means claimed after ordinary protection and pleading have failed.
Shade as shelter or protection supplies a defensive resource that the following negation empties of efficacy.
Sufficiency and availing name the efficacy explicitly denied to that supposed shelter.
Speech names the communicative resource declared unavailable just before the challenge.
Permission or authorization supplies the procedural channel that is explicitly withheld.
Excuse or apology supplies the defense that cannot be presented through the closed channel.

structural_cues: The negative sequence in 77:31 and 77:35-36 removes availing shelter, speech, permission, and excuse before 77:39 asks whether any resource remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several denied means followed by the conditional challenge; I infer that kayd is being treated as the addressees' last residual resource. It could instead be an independent taunt unrelated to the preceding resource failures.

changed_reading.before: If a plot exists, put it into action.
changed_reading.after: After shelter, speech, permission, and excuse have all failed, show any effective resource whatsoever that still remains to you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judicial separation and the gathering of present and former peoples immediately precede the plural lakum. The challenge can therefore address the pooled strategic capacity of the whole assembled opposition, not merely isolated personal schemes.

activation_trace.role: Plotting provides the resource that the assembled plural audience is challenged to pool and execute.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood defines the gathered scene as an adjudicated confrontation.
Joining dispersed parties into one whole supplies the collective audience immediately addressed by lakum.
Coalition around a shared matter sharpens gathering into the possibility of pooled opposition.

structural_cues: The clause We gathered you and the former in 77:38 directly supplies the antecedent audience for plural lakum and the plural imperative in 77:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an all-generations gathering, coalition imagery, and plural address; I infer that strategic capacity may be pooled across the assembly. Mere co-presence without cooperation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Each addressee may try an individual plot.
changed_reading.after: Let the entire gathered opposition, including the former peoples, consolidate every plan it has and direct the combined result against Me.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commands around the focus do not uniformly grant free and successful agency: some dispatch the condemned, some grant the protected enjoyment, one permits criminals only brief enjoyment, and one exposes refusal to bow. In that patterned field, fakiduni is a diagnostic dare whose failed performance manifests the verdict.

activation_trace.role: Forceful handling names the demanded performance whose efficacy the imperative tests.
Unimpeded departure supplies an imperative that dispatches the condemned into the reality they denied.
Literal eating supplies a command whose successful enjoyment corresponds to the protected group's status.
The same act of eating is commanded to criminals under a limiting frame, showing that imperative form alone does not imply approval or durable agency.
Enjoyable benefit supplies the temporarily permitted action whose brevity turns command into exposure.
Bending and lowering the head supplies a commanded act whose explicit nonperformance reveals the addressees' stance.

structural_cues: The imperative chain at 77:29-30, 77:39, 77:43, 77:46, and 77:48 assigns, limits, or tests action rather than simply authorizing it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated command pattern with sharply different outcomes; I infer a shared diagnostic function for fakiduni, where inability to fulfill the dare displays judgment. A genuine permission to attempt a plot remains grammatically possible.

changed_reading.before: The imperative grants an opportunity to act against the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The imperative sets a performance test whose inevitable failure publicly demonstrates that no effective agency remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sweeping force, destruction, projectile motion, and flying sparks provide a coherent conflict field for the war branch of kayd. The focus can consequently sound like an open challenge to wage battle against overwhelming force rather than a request for covert intrigue.

activation_trace.role: War and battle supply the focus's explicit but less common conflict sense.
A force that sweeps people away and destroys them supplies overwhelming hostile motion.
Falling into destruction gives the conflict field its demonstrated historical outcome.
Sending and throwing supplies projectile action that makes the confrontation spatial and kinetic.
Flying sparks provide the visible projectiles of the punitive scene.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly joins large-scale force and destruction to a final direct second-person confrontation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent sweeping, destruction, throwing, and sparks while the focus inventory supplies battle; I infer a battlefield frame. These images can remain punitive spectacle rather than literal warfare, so the model should not displace the stratagem reading.

changed_reading.before: War is only an isolated dictionary possibility for kayd.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding kinetic destruction activates an open battlefield dare: wage whatever battle you can against Me.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus kana is bracketed by what the addressees used to deny and what the protected used to do, followed by recompense. That temporal echo turns alleged possession of kayd into evidence tested against a settled record of prior stance and action.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication in the condition can look backward toward a capacity claimed across the addressees' prior history.
Stratagem supplies the alleged counter-course whose historical efficacy is being exposed.
Temporal predication places denial in the addressees' continuing prior record.
Contradiction of truth identifies the recorded stance that their supposed strategy served.
The repeated temporal construction places beneficial action in a contrasting prior record.
Intentional action supplies the conduct against which merely claimed strategic capacity is measured.
Answering an act with its recompense makes the prior record consequential rather than merely remembered.

structural_cues: The constructions kuntum bihi tukadhdhibun at 77:29 and bima kuntum ta'malun at 77:43 bracket the focus's kana lakum and contrast prior denial with prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated temporal construction, opposed prior records, and recompense; I infer that the focus condition exposes the historical record of claimed counter-capacity. Repetition of kana may instead be ordinary auxiliary usage without a deliberate bracket.

changed_reading.before: The condition asks only whether a plot is presently possessed.
changed_reading.after: The condition exposes whether the addressees' whole prior posture of denial ever produced a counter-strategy that can survive the reckoning now reached.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because strained crying is a peripheral kayd branch and the transitive imperative more naturally supports plotting. It remains anchored in the focus root and is sharply activated by the immediate loss of speech, permission, and excuse. Downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic resonance of futile last exertion, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative kiduni repeats the root whose inventory includes effortful strained crying.

activation_trace.role: Strained crying turns the demanded kayd into a last effort of voice.
Speech supplies the faculty explicitly absent, making any strained cry a failed edge case of expression.
Withheld permission closes the authorized channel for the attempted vocal act.
Excuse supplies the content the silenced exertion would seek but cannot deliver.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are challenged to produce a strategic act.
changed_reading.after: Even if all that remains is an effortful cry of resistance or excuse, strain it toward Me; the surrounding silence makes its futility audible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material activation is surprising because the slow-firestick branch is remote from the ordinary syntax of plotting. It remains anchored in the exact focus branch and coheres with the nearby flame throwing sparks. Downstream prose should mark it as an image-level analogy of failed counter-production, never as the lexical sense required by the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated kayd root includes a branch for laboriously drawing slow fire from a fire-stick.

activation_trace.role: Slow, effortful fire production supplies the attempted counter-force demanded by the challenge.
The tongue and blaze of fire provide the already active force against which counter-kindling would be attempted.
Sending and throwing make the surrounding fire an active emitter rather than passive heat.
Flying fire-sparks provide the abundant output contrasted with laborious extraction from a fire-stick.

changed_reading.after: Try to coax out any counter-fire or counter-force you can while the opposing blaze already throws immense sparks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the death-throes idiom normally concerns a soul struggling out, whereas kiduni carries a direct first-person object. It remains worth carrying because the branch is exact, the focus demands strenuous action, and the surah repeatedly supplies death and destruction. Downstream prose should qualify it as an embodied undertone of expiring resistance, not a syntactic paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory includes struggling as the soul departs, and the imperative demands that the root's action be spent against the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Struggle as the soul departs supplies an embodied limit-case for the addressees' remaining exertion.
Falling into annihilation supplies the historical horizon toward which futile resistance runs.
Loss of power and life makes death the terminal boundary of the demanded exertion.

changed_reading.before: The challenge concerns a plan that might still succeed.
changed_reading.after: Spend even the last bodily struggle of expiring resistance against Me; it cannot cross the death already built into the scene.

strongest_changes: The fixed appointment and arrived judgment close the temporal room in which a stratagem might defer the outcome.
The sequence of creating, placing, measuring, and destroying broadens kayd from cleverness to an audit of any rival operative power.
Failed shelter, silenced speech, withheld permission, and unavailable excuse make the condition a last-resource test with pragmatic disbelief.
The immediately gathered former and present peoples make plural lakum a challenge to the coalition's pooled strategic capacity.
The surah-wide imperative pattern makes fakiduni a diagnostic dare whose failed performance displays the verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed three long-range structures that a local reading could miss: a promise-to-appointment timeline, a repeated command system assigning different statuses, and the kana bracket between what people used to deny and what they used to do. These structures activate temporal, operational, collective, and evidentiary dimensions without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The forceful-handling and battle readings are directly branch-anchored, but it remains uncertain whether they should enter main prose as senses or only as activated resonances.
The repeated kana constructions may deliberately frame a settled record, or they may be ordinary auxiliaries whose bracketing force is reader-supplied.
Pooling the gathered audience's plans is coherent with the plural address but goes beyond mere co-presence.
The vocal, counter-fire, and death-struggle outliers require explicit qualification and should not displace the strong stratagem reading.
